title: Minigame modes
description: Rules of a minigame named by a mission step's params.mode (steps[].kind = minigame). The step gives the bar (pass_score, max_faults, time_limit_s, difficulty); the mode gives what is played: tasks the player answers (mechanic phan_loai: sort each task into one of `labels`) or performs (mechanic sap_xep: do the steps in `order`; `forbidden` tasks must never be done). Score = 100 x points of tasks done right / points of the tasks in play. A step passes (outcome dat) when every task is done, the score reaches pass_score, faults stay within max_faults, no critical task went wrong and time_limit_s did not run out; otherwise the step ends chua_dat and the mission's branch carries the consequence. Tasks with min_difficulty above the step's difficulty stay out of play, so the same mode is harder in a later chapter. Runtime: UHanoiMinigameSubsystem (UE), MinigameSystem (Unity core); reference model and golden plays: tools/runtime_rules.py.

description.description: What the player is doing and why it is hard, shown before the minigame.

protagonist.description: characters:<id> who plays it (the mission step's protagonist).

mechanic.description: phan_loai = sort every task into one label (a wrong label is a fault); sap_xep = perform tasks one at a time, a task is right only when every task of a lower order is already done, a forbidden task done is a fault.

stakes.description: Cause and effect of losing, in Vietnamese (Tứ diệu đế: what the loss costs and why).

labels.description: phan_loai: the bins a task can be sorted into.

order.description: sap_xep: position in the procedure; tasks sharing an order may be done in any order between themselves.

forbidden.description: sap_xep: an action that must never be done (it scores nothing and is a fault).

fault_weight.description: Faults counted when this task goes wrong (default 1).

critical.description: Getting this task wrong ends the minigame chua_dat at once, whatever the score (a dossier the bank will reject, a step that ruins the film).

min_difficulty.description: In play only when the step's params.difficulty is at least this (default 0).

amount_vnd.description: Money on this ledger line (ledger modes).

date.description: Month of this ledger line, YYYY-MM.

why.description: Vietnamese explanation shown after the answer (the cause the player should learn).

ledger.description: Ledger modes: how the runtime turns the sorted lines into the amount owed under the law (Bộ luật Dân sự 2015 Điều 468: interest above the legal cap has no effect; what was paid above the legal interest counts against the principal).

principal_label.description: Label whose amounts are the real principal.

capitalized_label.description: Label whose amounts are interest rolled into the principal on paper.

paid_label.description: Label whose amounts were paid to the lender.

expected_owed_vnd.description: What the story says (dialogue); the runtime's number must round to it (tests).

tolerance_vnd.description: Rounding the story allows ('khoảng bốn trăm sáu mươi triệu').

sources.description: Where the procedure or the numbers come from.
